news_headlines.title: Las Vegas police lock in 5 more years of VR officer training
news_headlines.summary: Wrap Technologies (NASDAQ: WRAP) has secured a five-year contract renewal with the Las Vegas Metropolitan Police Department Academy for its WrapReality™ virtual reality training platform. This renewal ensures continued hardware and software support, access to an expanding scenario library, and on-site training in Q2 2026 to enhance de-escalation and decision-making skills. The market reacted positively to the news, with WRAP stock gaining 8.05%, reflecting increased institutional adoption of its non-lethal and training platforms.

news_headlines.title: A $260M AI buildout will put 2,304 Nvidia B300 chips in one U.S. site
news_headlines.summary: Axe Compute (NASDAQ: AGPU) has secured a $260 million, three-year enterprise contract to deploy 2,304 NVIDIA B300 GPUs and AI-optimized high-speed storage in a single U.S. Tier 3 data center. This deal, the largest in the company's history, provides long-term revenue visibility, with deployment targeted for Q3 2026 and featuring a dedicated 4.8MW power supply and a take-or-pay payment structure. The contract highlights a shift towards tailored, dedicated AI infrastructure solutions for enterprises, moving away from the constraints of traditional hyperscalers.

news_headlines.title: Schneider Electric North America chief to lead Regal Rexnord

The current CEO, Louis Pinkham, will remain in his role until Paul's start date to ensure a smooth transition.
